description: This file defines the Java class 'ConceptReferenceTerm', which models a concept reference term used for mapping concepts to external coding systems like ICD9, ICD10, SNOMED in the OpenMRS system. It includes fields for identifiers, source, code, version, and related term mappings, along with methods for managing these attributes.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTerm
classes.description: Represents a term used as a reference for concepts, associating external codes and terminologies with internal concept metadata in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the concept reference term.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceTermId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the concept reference term.

methods.name: getConceptSource
methods.description: Returns the source (e.g., ICD, SNOMED) of the concept reference term.

methods.name: setConceptSource
methods.description: Sets the source (e.g., ICD, SNOMED) of the concept reference term.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code used to identify this reference term in its terminology system.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code to identify this reference term in its terminology system.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the reference term.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version of the reference term.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermMaps
methods.description: Returns the set of mappings associated with this reference term.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceTermMaps
methods.description: Sets the set of mappings associated with this reference term.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the getId method from the OpenmrsObject interface, returning the primary key.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements the setId method from the OpenmrsObject interface, setting the primary key.

methods.name: addConceptReferenceTermMap
methods.description: Adds a mapping to this concept reference term, avoiding duplicates and self-mapping.

methods.name: removeConceptReferenceTermMap
methods.description: Removes a specific mapping from this concept reference term.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining the name and code of the concept reference term.
